meta_data.base_class: Adjust <display settings> on a device for better readability - refers to user interface elements that can be scaled to change the appearance or interaction of the device interface.

tool_template.name: Device<class>Scaler
tool_template.description: Scale the <class> on your device for better readability.

scale_factor.description: Factor by which to scale the <class>. Must be between 0.5 and 3.0.

preview_before_apply.description: Whether to preview the <class> scaling effect before applying changes.

apply_to_all_screens.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the <class> scaling should be applied globally across all device screens.

context_mode.description: Usage context in which the <class> scaling should be optimized, e.g., reading, gaming, presentation, global.

auto_reset_time.description: Time duration (e.g., '10min', '1h', 'permanent') after which the scaling should automatically revert to default except 'permanent'.

transition_animation.description: Defines the animation style used during the scaling transition, e.g., smooth, instant, bounce.
